exposure: maternal severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus 2 (SARS-CoV-2) status
finding: Maternal SARS-CoV-2 positivity at delivery was independently associated with less initiation and shorter duration of any breastfeeding during month 2.
mod_finding: While the study doesn't directly examine the impact of mode of delivery on breastfeeding, it does find that mothers who tested positive for SARS-CoV-2 at delivery had lower odds of breastfeeding initiation and shorter breastfeeding duration, regardless of other factors including delivery mode.
